name: Collated
tagline: Photos and scans into one PDF, on your device.
about:
Collated turns phone photos, scans and PDFs into one tidy PDF in the browser. Nothing is uploaded: the pages are put in order, straightened and exported on your own device.

The mark is two pages, one laid over the other, with an amber rule on the front one: the moment loose pages become a set.
construction: On a 256 grid: two 128 × 164 pages with one 20-unit band and a 10-unit radius, the back one offset 48 right and 40 up and cut 14 clear of the front, and a 20-unit amber rule across the front page.

portfolio.alt: On a dark light table, a loose scatter of tilted photos and scans slides toward the middle, where the same pages lie squared into one neat stack, the top page marked with an amber rule.
